verdict.rationale: AMD's GAIA project (a companion software stack that runs on Ryzen/Ryzen AI hardware) exposes an Agent Framework with tool orchestration, an MCP client interface, and a plugin system, and AMD points to 'Ryzen AI Software For Developers' — evidence of an API/SDK layer for AI-native automation tied to the product ecosystem. However, this is not a documented public API for the CPU itself, and no formal API reference/spec (endpoints, schemas, auth) is provided, only high-level README bullet points. Missing for 10: a formal published API/SDK reference document, independent developer corroboration of using this API, and clarity on how it maps to controlling the 9950X3D itself rather than a separate software project.
